name: smart-columns
title: Smart Columns
description: Populate enum, boolean, text, and numeric columns from row content with Jev.

files.content:
TYPESAFE_API_KEY=your-typesafe-api-key
# Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32
# Store the same value as smart_columns_secret in Supabase Vault.
SMART_COLUMNS_SECRET=replace-with-a-random-secret-of-at-least-32-characters

docs: Replace the public.feedback example in supabase/functions/smart-columns/config.ts with the tables, input columns, and outputs to fill; if they are not specified, ask. Add the output columns and the smart_columns trigger to each table. Then follow https://supabase.com/library/docs/headless/smart-columns.md to generate the migration, configure secrets, and deploy.
